node.statement: By lem-prh-sharpness-family-arithmetic, P_lambda=A_lambda M_lambda is row-stochastic with rows (1-lambda,0,lambda,0), (0,1-lambda,0,lambda), ((1-lambda)^2,lambda*(1-lambda),lambda*(1-lambda),lambda^2), and (lambda*(1-lambda),(1-lambda)^2,lambda^2,lambda*(1-lambda)), and ||row_1(P_lambda)-row_3(P_lambda)||_1=2*lambda.
